newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Uniwear to raise capital,seek LSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Uniwear to raise capital,seek LSE listing.

text.p: Belgian textile holding company Uniwear SA will seek to raise up to 339.84 million francs and list its shares in London, the company's chief executive officer Andrea Cattaneo Della Volta told Reuters on Tuesday.
The capital increase, which Della Volta said would open "reasonably soon", will see a maximum of 1.18 million new shares offered to the public at 288 francs per share.
After the capital increase the company will apply for listing on either London's main bourse, the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) or the SEAQ system, said Della Volta.

Listed U.K. company Mackie International PLC, which manufactures linen spinning machines, will subscribe for 330,000 Uniwear shares at 288 francs each, in what Della Volta described as a "strategic alliance".
Uniwear shares closed Tuesday at 212 francs, up one franc on the day at a new 1996 high.
Last December Uniwear agreed to acquire more than 35 percent of listed U.K. hosiery manufacturer Pex PLC.
